title: First-Run SDK Starter Kit: inline screenshots, code callouts, and micro-animations for auth & streaming
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a compact SDK "first-run" starter kit of assets and inline screenshot treatments to be embedded in API and SDK onboarding docs. Focus areas: key management (masked examples, rotation callouts), streaming response UI (skeleton states and partial tokens), and tool-calling examples (structured output with function signatures). Deliverables include annotated screenshots for mobile and desktop, short micro-animation exports for streaming, and a single-page asset bundle for the docs site.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated desktop+mobile screenshots for: API key creation, masked key display, key rotation flow
Micro-animations (MP4 + Lottie fallback) showing streaming tokens appearing and KV-cache highlight
Tool-call example screenshots with structured JSON output and UI callouts explaining parameters and safe-guards
All assets provided in docs-ready sizes (640x360, 1200x675, 1920x1080) with source Figma file and export checklist
Security review sign-off confirming no real keys or customer data shown (mock placeholders only)
Accessibility pass for color contrast and reduced-motion preference

design_notes: Use masked key UI with explicit 'copy' button; avoid showing full token anywhere in image exports
Prefer vector callouts (SVG) for code highlights to keep text selectable in docs where possible
Micro-animations should degrade to a static GIF or MP4 for non-JS viewers — provide both Lottie + MP4
Streaming visuals: emphasize partial token reveal, show delta between cached prefix and new tokens (KV cache highlight)
Tool-calling visuals: present both the tool schema and the returned structured JSON side-by-side with callouts explaining safety checks
accessibility_considerations: All text >= 4.5:1 contrast for body text; 3:1 for UI labels where larger size applies
Provide alternative text for every screenshot and a short transcript for micro-animations
Honor prefers-reduced-motion; provide static fallback images and a brief note in embed code
Ensure keyboard focus states are shown for copy-to-clipboard controls in screenshots
